As she listened to him, Cosette’s eyes wandered vaguely about. This simple man sufficed for Cosette’s thought, the same as the wild garden sufficed for her eyes. When she had had a good chase after the butterflies, she came panting up to him and said: “Ah! How I have run!” He kissed her brow. Cosette adored the goodman. She was always at his heels. Where Jean Valjean was, there happiness was.
